summary: Milestone 2026.05.221 completed 0 experiments with 0 minutes of recorded wall time — the conductor pipeline was inactive during this milestone window. No compute-bound tasks ran, so GPU idle state is not applicable.
bottlenecks_identified: Pipeline inactivity: no experiment commits were recorded since milestone activation. The conductor may not have been started, or the milestone was skipped without a retro task queued.
improvements_suggested: Ensure the conductor is started immediately after milestone activation to avoid zero-experiment milestones.
Add a milestone-activation watchdog (e.g., a cron alert or supervisor check) that fires if no experiment is committed within 30 minutes of activation.
Queue at least one lightweight synthesis task (schema validation, doc reconciliation) as a fallback so every milestone produces at least one artifact.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Start the conductor promptly after milestone activation — zero-experiment milestones waste the milestone slot entirely.
Wire a supervisor heartbeat that alerts when no task has launched within 30 minutes of activation, so inactivity is caught early rather than at retro time.
Pre-stage at least one low-cost infrastructure task (e.g., exclusion-manifest lint, known-issues audit) in research-roadmap-next.yaml so even a stalled milestone produces an artifact.
meta_reflection: A zero-experiment milestone is a scheduling failure, not a research failure — the pipeline simply did not run. The correct operational response is to ensure the conductor is activated immediately and that a fallback task is always pre-staged. No GPU efficiency analysis is possible when no compute-bound tasks ran.
